content:
BUILT CoLAB was present at the third annual meeting of Collaborative Laboratories – CoLAB’s that took place on 6 and 7 December at the University of Algarve, and was organised by ANI – National Agency for Innovation.

This event discussed the evolution of CoLAB activities and their integration in the dynamics of regional ecosystems, during the transition to a new cycle of core funding under the Interface Mission and the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (RRP).

João Moutinho, from BUILT CoLAB, represented this Collaborative Laboratory, having presented to the audience the main results of 2022 and the perspectives for 2023.

The event was attended by Joana Mendonça, President of ANI, Madalena Alves, President of the Foundation for Science and Technology (FCT), João Mendes Borga, Member of the Board of ANI, and Paulo Águas, Rector of the University of Algarve.

ANI also paid tribute at the opening of the event, with a minute’s silence in memory of Paulo Fonseca.
